Definition: Ammihud, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: The name Ammihud belongs to three men, and the Bible keeps them apart by their sons. Ammihud is the father of Elishama, the captain of Ephraim in the wilderness; Ammihud is the father of Shemuel, the prince of Simeon who divides the land; and Ammihud is the father of Talmai, the king of Geshur who shelters Absalom.
TheologicalSignificance: Three sons, three houses, one name: one Ammihud gives a captain, one gives a prince, and one gives a king who hides a fugitive.
